mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses (expense_desc, amount, expense_date, category, is_trend_related, transaction_type, is_settlement) VALUES (#{expenseDesc}, #{amount}, #{expenseDate}, #{category}, #{isTrendRelated}, #{transactionType}, #{isSettlement})
mapper.update: UPDATE expenses SET expense_desc = #{request.expenseDesc}, amount = #{request.amount}, expense_date = #{request.expenseDate}, category = #{request.category}, is_trend_related = #{request.isTrendRelated}, transaction_type = #{request.transactionType}, is_settlement = #{request.isSettlement} WHERE expense_id = #{expenseId}
mapper.select: SELECT expense_id AS expenseId, expense_desc AS expenseDesc, amount, expense_date AS expenseDate, category, is_trend_related AS isTrendRelated, transaction_type AS transactionType, is_settlement AS isSettlement, created_at AS createdAt FROM expenses ORDER BY expense_date DESC, expense_id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND is_settlement = false THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS netPersonalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'INCOME' AND is_settlement = false THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS netPersonalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) AS balance FROM expenses
